subject: Site Engineer application, Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.company_line: ASX-listed infrastructure services company delivering asset remediation, repair and strengthening across Victoria
letter.subject: Application: Site Engineer - Asset Remediation Victoria
paragraphs: I am applying for the Site Engineer role with SRG Global Asset Remediation in Victoria, listed on SEEK. The role supports maintenance, repair and strengthening works across civil and structural assets.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge engineer at JustBuilt and as field engineer at Grand Travaux, including methodical inspections, quality checks, progress reporting and coordination with engineers and suppliers. I have not yet worked on Australian asset remediation projects.

I live in Melton Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site work across Victoria.
I have attached my resume. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
